notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Focused on improving the menu experience and Vive controllers. Menu naviagtion has been completely overhauled.

*Use triggers for all menus
*Fix for the lap counter on Astute City on Vive
*Use right Vive touch-pad for right menu navigation in lobby
*Vive controller inputs are now mappable in controller settings
*Can now cycle menu tabs with strafe buttons
*Added autoscrolling to non-gaze menu navigation 
*Added Vive and Xbox controller diagrams

notes.title: We're listening.
notes.content: After reading and watching everything we could find about our game, we have decided to lower the price. We’re taking care of the early adopters because customer satisfaction is our number one priority. We feel this now puts us in-line with other titles in similar genres. For more details, check out the Discussion Section.  Thank you everyone for your feedback and support.
